item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your calendar is full of reminders to pause, breathe, and reset, and your body needs the same attention. Dehydration quietly drains focus and patience, and it makes stress feel heavier than it is. Don't wait for thirst. Start the morning with water before anything else, and keep a bottle within reach all day. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
